## 🎨 Diagrammes de Responsabilités

### COMMAND: Qu'est-ce qu'il FAIT vs NE FAIT JAMAIS

Ce diagramme montre clairement les limites d'une COMMAND.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-command-responsibilities
%%| fig-cap: "Responsabilités d'une COMMAND"
flowchart TD
    Start([User Input]) --> Parse["✅ PARSE<br/>Extract arguments"]

    Parse --> Validate["✅ VALIDATE<br/>Check requirements<br/>Ask if unclear"]

    Validate --> Decision{Strategy?}

    Decision -->|Independent| Parallel["✅ ORCHESTRATE<br/>Launch agents PARALLEL"]
    Decision -->|Dependent| Sequential["✅ ORCHESTRATE<br/>Launch agents SEQUENTIAL"]
    Decision -->|Large Data| Batch["✅ ORCHESTRATE<br/>Launch agents BATCH"]

    Parallel --> Aggregate["✅ AGGREGATE<br/>Collect results<br/>Handle errors"]
    Sequential --> Aggregate
    Batch --> Aggregate

    Aggregate --> Report["✅ REPORT<br/>Summary stats<br/>Success/Fail counts<br/>Metrics"]

    Report --> End([User Summary])

    Start -.❌ NEVER.-> Execute["❌ Execute tasks<br/>❌ Read/Write files<br/>❌ Call APIs<br/>❌ Transform data<br/>❌ Apply logic"]

    Execute -.-> ErrorZone["COMMAND should<br/>NEVER do this!<br/>(delegate to agents)"]

    classDef do fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef dont fill:#F44336,stroke:#C62828,color:#fff
    classDef decision fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff

    class Parse,Validate,Parallel,Sequential,Batch,Aggregate,Report do
    class Execute,ErrorZone dont
    class Decision decision
```

## 🔄 Command ↔ Multiple Agents Interaction

### Sequence Diagram: Parallel Coordination

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-command-agents-parallel
%%| fig-cap: "Séquence: COMMAND coordonne plusieurs agents (Parallel)"
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CMD as Command<br/>Orchestrator
    participant A1 as Agent 1<br/>Translator-ES
    participant A2 as Agent 2<br/>Translator-FR
    participant A3 as Agent 3<br/>Translator-DE
    participant AGG as Aggregator

    User->>+CMD: /translate-multi "Hello world" [es,fr,de]

    Note over CMD: Phase 1: PARSE
    Note over CMD: Parse arguments & validate

    CMD->>CMD: Validate: All locales exist ✅

    Note over CMD: Phase 2: VALIDATE

    CMD->>CMD: Choose Strategy: PARALLEL

    Note over CMD: Phase 3: ORCHESTRATE

    CMD->>+A1: Task("Translate to Spanish")
    CMD->>+A2: Task("Translate to French")
    CMD->>+A3: Task("Translate to German")

    Note over A1,A3: All agents run CONCURRENTLY

    A1-->>-AGG: Spanish translation
    A2-->>-AGG: French translation
    A3-->>-AGG: German translation

    Note over CMD: Phase 4: AGGREGATE

    AGG->>CMD: All results collected

    Note over CMD: Phase 5: REPORT

    CMD-->>-User: Summary: 3/3 translations<br/>Time: 5 min<br/>Cost: $2<br/>Speedup: 3x
```

### Sequence Diagram: Sequential Coordination

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-command-agents-sequential
%%| fig-cap: "Séquence: COMMAND coordonne agents (Sequential)"
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CMD as Command<br/>CI/CD
    participant B as Builder<br/>Agent
    participant T as Tester<br/>Agent
    participant D as Deployer<br/>Agent

    User->>+CMD: /ci-cd-pipeline staging

    Note over CMD: Phase 1: PARSE & VALIDATE

    CMD->>CMD: Validate branch exists ✅

    Note over CMD: Phase 2: ORCHESTRATE (SEQUENTIAL)

    CMD->>+B: Task("Build app")
    Note over B: Phase 1: BUILD
    B-->>-CMD: ✅ Build artifacts

    Note over CMD: Wait & Validate Gate 1

    CMD->>+T: Task("Run tests")
    Note over T: Phase 2: TEST
    T-->>-CMD: ✅ Tests pass (coverage 85%)

    Note over CMD: Wait & Validate Gate 2

    CMD->>+D: Task("Deploy")
    Note over D: Phase 3: DEPLOY
    D-->>-CMD: ✅ Deployed to staging

    Note over CMD: Phase 3: AGGREGATE<br/>Phase 4: REPORT

    CMD-->>-User: Pipeline complete ✅<br/>Build: ✅<br/>Tests: ✅ (85%)<br/>Deploy: ✅<br/>Time: 60 min
```

## 🎯 Lifecycle d'une COMMAND

### State Machine: Les 5 Phases

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-command-lifecycle
%%| fig-cap: "Lifecycle d'une COMMAND: Parse → Validate → Orchestrate → Aggregate → Report"
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Parse

    Parse --> ParseSuccess : ✅ Arguments parsed
    Parse --> ParseFailed : ❌ Invalid format
    ParseFailed --> [*] : Error to user

    ParseSuccess --> Validate

    Validate --> ValidateSuccess : ✅ All valid
    Validate --> AskUser : ❓ Missing/unclear
    AskUser --> Validate : User provides input
    Validate --> ValidateFailed : ❌ Invalid data
    ValidateFailed --> [*] : Error to user

    ValidateSuccess --> Orchestrate

    Orchestrate --> ChooseStrategy : Decide: Parallel/Sequential/Batch
    ChooseStrategy --> LaunchParallel : Independent tasks
    ChooseStrategy --> LaunchSequential : Dependent tasks
    ChooseStrategy --> LaunchBatch : Large dataset

    LaunchParallel --> Monitoring : Monitor progress
    LaunchSequential --> Monitoring
    LaunchBatch --> Monitoring

    Monitoring --> Aggregate

    Aggregate --> Collect : Collect all results
    Collect --> HandleErrors : Check for failures
    HandleErrors --> Retry : Retry once if fail
    Retry --> AggregateComplete : All results collected
    AggregateComplete --> Report

    Report --> GenerateSummary : Success/Fail stats
    GenerateSummary --> GenerateMetrics : Time, cost, speedup
    GenerateMetrics --> ReturnUser

    ReturnUser --> [*] : Return summary to user

    note right of Parse
        Extract arguments from
        user command input
    end note

    note right of Validate
        Verify requirements met
        Ask if unclear
    end note

    note right of ChooseStrategy
        Parallel: independent tasks
        Sequential: dependencies
        Batch: 100+ items
    end note

    note right of HandleErrors
        Retry once
        Then report status
    end note
```

## 🏗️ Architecture: COMMAND as Orchestrator Hub

### Architecture Diagram

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-command-architecture
%%| fig-cap: "COMMAND comme hub central d'orchestration"
graph TB
    subgraph User["👤 User Input"]
        Cmd["/command-name args"]
    end

    subgraph CommandLayer["⚙️ COMMAND ORCHESTRATOR"]
        Parse["1. Parse<br/>Arguments"]
        Validate["2. Validate<br/>Inputs"]
        Orchestrate["3. Orchestrate<br/>Strategy"]
        Aggregate["4. Aggregate<br/>Results"]
        Report["5. Report<br/>Summary"]
    end

    subgraph AgentLayer["🤖 AGENTS (Executors)"]
        A1["Agent 1<br/>Domain A"]
        A2["Agent 2<br/>Domain B"]
        A3["Agent 3<br/>Domain C"]
        AN["Agent N<br/>Domain N"]
    end

    subgraph OutputLayer["📊 Output"]
        Summary["Summary<br/>Success/Fail<br/>Metrics"]
    end

    Cmd --> Parse
    Parse --> Validate
    Validate --> Orchestrate

    Orchestrate -->|Launch| A1
    Orchestrate -->|Launch| A2
    Orchestrate -->|Launch| A3
    Orchestrate -->|Launch| AN

    A1 -->|Result| Aggregate
    A2 -->|Result| Aggregate
    A3 -->|Result| Aggregate
    AN -->|Result| Aggregate

    Aggregate --> Report
    Report --> Summary

    classDef command fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef agent fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff
    classDef user fill:#9C27B0,stroke:#6A1B9A,color:#fff
    classDef output fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff

    class Parse,Validate,Orchestrate,Aggregate,Report command
    class A1,A2,A3,AN agent
    class Cmd user
    class Summary output
```

## ❌ vs ✅ Comparison: WRONG vs RIGHT

### Wrong Approach: COMMAND tries to execute

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-wrong-command
%%| fig-cap: "❌ WRONG: COMMAND exécute des tâches (antipattern)"
graph TD
    User["👤 User"] --> CMD["❌ COMMAND<br/>tries to execute"]

    CMD --> ReadFile["Read files"]
    CMD --> ParseData["Parse data"]
    CMD --> Transform["Transform data"]
    CMD --> WriteFile["Write files"]
    CMD --> CallAPI["Call APIs"]

    ReadFile --> Problem["⚠️ PROBLEMS:<br/>• Slow execution<br/>• No parallelism<br/>• Single point of failure<br/>• Hard to scale<br/>• No error recovery"]
    ParseData --> Problem
    Transform --> Problem
    WriteFile --> Problem
    CallAPI --> Problem

    Problem --> BadOutcome["❌ BAD OUTCOMES:<br/>• 1x speedup (no parallelism)<br/>• Low reliability<br/>• Hard to debug<br/>• Can't reuse agents"]

    classDef wrong fill:#F44336,stroke:#C62828,color:#fff
    classDef problem fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef bad fill:#C62828,stroke:#880E4F,color:#fff

    class CMD,ReadFile,ParseData,Transform,WriteFile,CallAPI wrong
    class Problem problem
    class BadOutcome bad
```

### Right Approach: COMMAND coordinates agents

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-right-command
%%| fig-cap: "✅ RIGHT: COMMAND coordonne agents (pattern correct)"
graph TD
    User["👤 User"] --> CMD["✅ COMMAND<br/>orchestrates"]

    CMD --> Parse["Parse input"]
    CMD --> Validate["Validate input"]
    CMD --> Decide["Decide strategy:<br/>Parallel/Sequential/Batch"]

    Decide -->|Parallel| LaunchAll["Launch all agents"]
    Decide -->|Sequential| LaunchSeq["Launch in sequence"]
    Decide -->|Batch| LaunchBatch["Launch in batches"]

    LaunchAll --> Agent1["Agent 1"]
    LaunchAll --> Agent2["Agent 2"]
    LaunchAll --> Agent3["Agent 3"]

    LaunchSeq --> AgentA["Agent A"]
    LaunchSeq --> AgentB["Agent B"]

    LaunchBatch --> Batch1["Batch Wave 1"]
    LaunchBatch --> Batch2["Batch Wave 2"]

    Agent1 --> Results["Aggregate<br/>Results"]
    Agent2 --> Results
    Agent3 --> Results
    AgentA --> Results
    AgentB --> Results
    Batch1 --> Results
    Batch2 --> Results

    Results --> Report["Report<br/>Summary"]

    Report --> GoodOutcome["✅ GOOD OUTCOMES:<br/>• 5-96x speedup<br/>• High reliability<br/>• Easy to scale<br/>• Reusable agents<br/>• Error recovery"]

    classDef right fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef agent fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff
    classDef result fill:#9C27B0,stroke:#6A1B9A,color:#fff
    classDef good fill:#1B5E20,stroke:#00600D,color:#fff

    class CMD,Parse,Validate,Decide right
    class Agent1,Agent2,Agent3,AgentA,AgentB,Batch1,Batch2 agent
    class Results,Report result
    class GoodOutcome good
```

## 📊 Decision Tree: Choosing Strategy

### Flowchart: Comment choisir Parallel vs Sequential vs Batch

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-strategy-decision
%%| fig-cap: "Arbre de décision: Choisir la stratégie d'orchestration"
flowchart TD
    Start([Nouvelle tâche]) --> Q1{Les tâches sont-elles<br/>indépendantes?}

    Q1 -->|Oui| Q2{Nombre d'items?}
    Q1 -->|Non| Sequential["🔗 SEQUENTIAL<br/><br/>Tâches dépendantes<br/>Exécution en ordre<br/>Quality gates<br/>Exemple: CI/CD<br/>(Build → Test → Deploy)"]

    Q2 -->|Petite<br/>10-50| Parallel["⚡ PARALLEL<br/><br/>Toutes les tâches<br/>lancées ensemble<br/>Speedup: 5-20x<br/>Exemple: Translation<br/>(15 langues)"]
    Q2 -->|Grande<br/>100+| Batch["📦 BATCH<br/><br/>Tâches divisées en vagues<br/>20 items par wave<br/>Speedup: 10-15x<br/>Exemple: Localization<br/>(174 locales)"]

    Sequential --> Impl1["Implémentation:<br/>Task(agent1)<br/>Wait for completion<br/>Task(agent2)<br/>Wait for completion<br/>..."]
    Parallel --> Impl2["Implémentation:<br/>Task(agent1)<br/>Task(agent2)<br/>...Task(agentN)<br/>Wait for all<br/>Aggregate results"]
    Batch --> Impl3["Implémentation:<br/>FOR each wave:<br/>  Task(agent1...20)<br/>  Wait for wave<br/>  Check errors<br/>Aggregate all waves"]

    Impl1 --> Done1["✅ Sequential complete<br/>Quality first<br/>No parallelism"]
    Impl2 --> Done2["✅ Parallel complete<br/>5-20x speedup<br/>All agents run together"]
    Impl3 --> Done3["✅ Batch complete<br/>10-15x speedup<br/>Controlled waves"]

    classDef decision fill:#FF9800,stroke:#E65100,color:#fff
    classDef seq fill:#2196F3,stroke:#1565C0,color:#fff
    classDef par fill:#4CAF50,stroke:#2E7D32,color:#fff
    classDef batch fill:#9C27B0,stroke:#6A1B9A,color:#fff

    class Q1,Q2 decision
    class Sequential,Impl1,Done1 seq
    class Parallel,Impl2,Done2 par
    class Batch,Impl3,Done3 batch
```
